findings.technical_description: Foreign and nonexistent shipment ids accepted by declaration creation
findings.business_consequence: Cross-tenant references and orphan customs records; tested reads did not expose foreign shipment contents.
findings.reproduction_procedure: POST /v1/declarations using synthetic tenant B shipment id or random UUID from tenant A.
findings.observed_behavior: Before201 for both; after400, foreign-id query empty.
findings.root_cause: Missing parent ownership check before insert.
findings.recommended_fix: Scoped parent lookup/lock and explicit tenant update predicate.
findings.residual_risk: Historical mismatched rows and composite foreign keys remain unverified.

findings.technical_description: Enum-only lifecycle permits unjustified state jumps
findings.business_consequence: Customs/payment state can be marked without complete preceding workflow or external evidence.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Draft→PAID API call; inspect remaining branches for draft→ASSESSED and backwards transitions.
findings.expected_behavior: Only authorized valid transitions with required evidence.
findings.observed_behavior: Before draft→paid200; after400. Paid/released prerequisites implemented; complete graph/evidence still absent.
findings.root_cause: No complete explicit transition graph or domain-evidence model.
findings.recommended_fix: Define full matrix with product/domain owner; enforce locked transitions, proof and immutable final-state edit policy.
findings.verification_status: PASS for corrected guards; NOT VERIFIED for complete graph
findings.residual_risk: Manual assessment/payment trust remains a release blocker.

findings.technical_description: FX outage silently returned invented rate2540
findings.business_consequence: Incorrect landed-cost/tax estimates with apparent provider provenance.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Simulate https.get transport error in isolated FX test.
findings.expected_behavior: Fail explicitly or require a verified manual override.
findings.observed_behavior: Before resolved2540; after rejects with actionable FX error.
findings.root_cause: Hardcoded/stale success fallback hid provider failure.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove invented fallback; validate finite positive response.
findings.residual_risk: Live FX authority, malformed upstream variants and non-USD stale cache remain unverified.

findings.technical_description: Unawaited release-event insertion and unlocked status/chain writes
findings.business_consequence: Lost/duplicate or prematurely dispatched audit/downstream processing.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Three concurrent PAID calls; release subscriber queries independently committed declaration state.
findings.expected_behavior: Single transition event; valid hash chain; consumers observe committed release.
findings.observed_behavior: One PAID event and valid chain; release subscriber sees RELEASED and persisted domain event.
findings.root_cause: Unawaited transaction promise and missing row serialization.
findings.recommended_fix: Lock status/chain parent, deduplicate status, await event insertion and defer dispatch until commit.
findings.residual_risk: Crash recovery/outbox delivery and transfer notification timing not verified.

findings.technical_description: Repository typecheck fails on shared API defects
findings.business_consequence: Clean supported release/build cannot be established for ClearOS dependency graph.
findings.expected_behavior: Zero compile errors and all downstream checks run.
findings.observed_behavior: Nonzero exit; duplicate quotationRoutes plus consultant/marketplace/metrics/launch/test diagnostics.
findings.root_cause: Conflicting imports and shared type/API drift.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve each module against its actual types; rerun root gates and full build.
findings.residual_risk: Runtime transpilation passing targeted tests does not prove a production build.

findings.technical_description: Advisory scan reports vulnerabilities but cannot block CI
findings.business_consequence: Known affected dependencies can reach release without risk triage.
findings.reproduction_procedure: npm audit --json --ignore-scripts; inspect advisory CI step.
findings.expected_behavior: Reachability triaged and mandatory security gate enforced.
findings.observed_behavior: 27 affected package entries:4critical/6high/14moderate/3low; CI step explicitly nonblocking.
findings.recommended_fix: Triage deployed/build/test paths, update with compatibility tests and require accepted gate.
findings.residual_risk: Registry severity is not a reproduced app exploit; no force upgrades applied.

findings.technical_description: No-match result becomes clear without source completeness/freshness prerequisite
findings.business_consequence: Unavailable/empty/stale corpus can imply misleading compliance clearance.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Inspect screenSubject→screenName and separate getLastSyncStatus; reproduce on a separate empty-reference test DB before release.
findings.expected_behavior: Unavailable coverage yields blocked/unknown, with source freshness and completeness recorded.
findings.observed_behavior: Source sets clear when matches array is empty; sync health is not consulted on decision path.
findings.root_cause: Matching absence treated as clearance; source availability is separate metadata.
findings.recommended_fix: Require domain-approved source freshness/completeness, bounded atomic sync, reconcile removals and distinguish unavailable from clear.
findings.verification_status: CONFIRMED STATIC LOGIC GAP; live failure NOT VERIFIED
findings.residual_risk: No shared reference data was deleted or source sync invoked.

findings.technical_description: Historical audit probes can pass while recording unsafe responses
findings.business_consequence: Green audit test count can be misread as behavior assurance.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Inspect cases with requests and evidence assignments but no safe-response assertion.
findings.expected_behavior: Probes labeled observations; release regressions assert invariants.
findings.observed_behavior: Existing probes have no status assertion for some inputs.
findings.root_cause: Evidence collection and pass/fail acceptance mixed in same suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep probes separate and add assertion-based cases for each critical invariant.

findings.technical_description: SBOM generation fails dependency consistency validation
findings.business_consequence: Artifact dependency inventory/provenance not established by native SBOM command.
findings.expected_behavior: Valid machine-readable SBOM from actual dependency tree.
findings.observed_behavior: ESBOMPROBLEMS: request alias and bn.js overrides conflict with dependents required ranges.
findings.root_cause: Security overrides do not satisfy original transitive dependency metadata.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile upstream dependencies/overrides and generate/validate artifact SBOM.
findings.residual_risk: Not proof overrides are exploitable; generated error file is not an SBOM.

findings.business_consequence: Recovery of customs/financial/document operations after loss is unproven.
findings.reproduction_procedure: Provide isolated production-equivalent encrypted backup restore and application/reconciliation exercise.
findings.expected_behavior: Measured RTO/RPO and restored workflows, objects/config/secrets/roles.
findings.observed_behavior: Restore script inspected; no authorized isolated production backup exercise available.
findings.root_cause: Missing operational evidence, not a reproduced restore defect.
findings.recommended_fix: Run controlled restore/rollback exercise with SRE and business-invariant reconciliation.
findings.residual_risk: No production access or destructive restore attempted.
